notes:
Lead origin: inbound from marketing article + webinar on content automation. Product: ContentBento Studio — SaaS platform that generates long-form articles, microblogs, and subject-line variants for email campaigns. High-volume workflow: nightly batch jobs that produce 2–5k short outputs/day plus on-demand article drafts (100–200 requests/day).

Primary asks / quotes from call:
- 'We need predictable unit cost for bulk runs — cost per 1k outputs matters.'
- 'Caching of prefixes and a sensible batching strategy could cut costs by 30% — want Redwood recommendations.'
- 'Don't need on-prem; public cloud ok, but SOC2/SAML required for some customers.'

Performance targets: mostly cost-sensitive. SLOs: 95th pct latency < 500ms for short prompts (subject lines), acceptable 2–4s for long-form drafts. Throughput target: sustain bursts of 200 r/s for short prompts during morning campaign windows.

Model preferences: open to smaller quantized models for cost-sensitive batches; might route high-quality drafts to larger models. Interested in automated fallback to cheaper variants when Dedicated capacity not required.

POC ask: 7-day hosted API POC — test batching & prefix caching, evaluate per-token spend vs quality, measure tail latency during scheduled campaign bursts. Priya to provide test prompt sets and expected traffic curve.

Security: needs SSO/SAML for internal admin; SOC2 attestation preferred; basic audit logging and retention controls. Data residency not required.
